summary: TETRA Technologies filed an 8-K on June 2, 2026, announcing a $100 million underwritten public offering of common stock with an over-allotment option of up to $15 million. The proceeds will partially fund the Arkansas Bromine Project, for which the board approved a final investment decision subject to financing. The offering is a routine capital raise via an existing shelf registration statement. It does not represent a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The filing also provides operational updates but no event that triggers a special-situations category.
